'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mauer DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mauer]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move|VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
